headline: Uganda Inflation Jumps to 5.8% in October Driven by Currency Depreciation
summary: Uganda's annual inflation accelerated to 5.8% in October from 4.6% in September, fueled by rising food costs and a weaker shilling, official statistics show.
why: Uganda's inflation rate determines policy interest rates set by the Bank of Uganda, affecting sovereign yields and frontier debt valuations in East Africa.

impacts.name: Ugandan shilling
impacts.why: A weaker shilling directly increased domestic consumer prices, driving inflation up to 5.8%.
